content: {"summary":"Inventory-service pods could not resolve their database hostname on 24 Mar 2026 while datastore VMs could, because the pods use the cluster CoreDNS which forwards queries randomly to two authoritative DNS servers that were inconsistent during a zone rollout.","likely_cause":"A partial DNS zone rollout left one of the internal DNS servers without the inventory-db-01 record; pods (which use random upstream via CoreDNS) received NXDOMAIN, whereas VMs queried the first server that still had the record.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"A partial rollout left one authoritative DNS server without the inventory-db-01 record, causing pods (which use random upstream via CoreDNS) to see NXDOMAIN while VMs (which query the first server) resolve correctly.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#1","RB-020#2","RB-020#3","RB-020#10"],"quote":"VMs list both servers in `/etc/resolv.conf`, internal-dns-01 first."}] ,"next_checks":["Run dig @10.0.0.53 and @10.0.0.54 for inventory-db-01.prod.internal to compare answers","Check SOA serials on both DNS servers for consistency","Inspect recent zone rollout logs for partial updates or failures","Verify that the inventory-db-01 record exists on both internal-dns servers","If needed, restart the cluster CoreDNS deployment to clear cached negative answers"]}
